name: BMW
description:
BMW (Bayerische Motoren Werke AG) is a German multinational automaker headquartered in Munich, known for luxury cars, sports sedans, and motorcycles. Its slogan is "Freude am Fahren" ("The Ultimate Driving Machine").

Key Highlights

• Origins: Founded in 1916 (originally linked to aircraft engine manufacturing), BMW began making motorcycles in the 1920s and entered car production in 1928.
• Brands: Alongside the core BMW lineup (including BMW M performance models and BMW i electric vehicles), BMW Group includes MINI, Rolls-Royce, and BMW Motorrad.
• Design & Identity: Recognizable for driver-focused cockpits, sporty handling, the twin kidney grille, and the Hofmeister kink.
• Lineup & Powertrains: Offers sedans, coupes, SUVs/SAVs, wagons, and roadsters with internal combustion, hybrid, and all-electric drivetrains.
